//: colign-frontend deployed as the standalone MF REMOTE. The host (app.colign.org) fetches remoteEntry.js + chunks cross-origin from this project's domain, so every asset needs Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Build this project with PUBLIC_PATH=/ so Vite emits root-relative asset paths (the default prod base is /wc/, which would 404 when served at the domain root). See DEPLOY.md.
